indicator_name: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets, deposit takers (IMF FSI)
description: Достаточность капитала депозитных организаций: регулятивный капитал к активам, взвешенным по риску (МВФ FSI)
methodology: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (dataflow IMF.STA/FSIC), core indicators for deposit takers, reported by the Kazakh authorities (NBK, then ARDFM), quarterly. Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets, %, deposit takers, end of quarter. Equal to NBK CAPITAL_ADEQUACY_RATIO (form 314) over 2019Q4-2024Q1 to 0.005 pp.
